messages:
alex_support: Heads-up — customer reported invoice mismatch: tokens on invoice ~60k, dashboard shows ~95k for same period. They say it happens after mid-stream client disconnects during streaming chat. Attaching sample logs.

chao_engineering: Can you paste a couple of request_ids and the raw stream events? We need one example to repro.

alex_support: Request IDs: req_6251f2, req_6251f3. From logs:
```
2026-02-19T18:02:12Z request_id=req_6251f2 event=chunk size_tokens=120
2026-02-19T18:02:14Z request_id=req_6251f2 event=chunk size_tokens=60
2026-02-19T18:02:14Z connection=client_close request_id=req_6251f2
2026-02-19T18:02:14Z request_id=req_6251f2 finalize=SKIPPED reason=client_disconnect
```
They see "finalize=SKIPPED" frequently. Invoice seems to only count finalized requests.

lydia_obs: I ran the dashboard query for customer.acme between 02/10-02/20 — total tokens (dashboard) = 95,178, invoice = 60,120. Here is the query we use to compute dashboard tokens (simplified):
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM streaming_events WHERE request_id = ... GROUP BY customer
```
The invoice pipeline sums finalized_requests.tokens only.

maria_billing: That aligns with billing pipeline behavior — we only include requests marked finalized by the billing worker. If the worker sees a socket close without a done event, it currently flags it SKIPPED. Might be policy but customer expects partial tokens to be billed.

chao_engineering: This looks like a finalize-on-close logic bug. For streaming endpoints we should flush partial token counts to the billing stream when the connection closes unexpectedly. Right now we only flush on `event: done` or explicit server-side finalize.

chao_engineering: Quick repro steps I used locally:
1) Start streaming chat with SDK or curl -N to /v1/stream
2) Send a partial generation (server sends a few chunk events)
3) Kill the client (SIGINT) before sending cancel/close handshake
4) Watch server logs: no finalize emitted, billing worker marks SKIPPED

Example curl style repro (SSE):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}' &
sleep 1; kill %1  # simulate abrupt client close
```

infra-bot: billing_worker.v2 detected 12 SKIPPED finalizes for customer.acme in window 2026-02-10..2026-02-20 (avg partial_tokens=420)

maria_billing: Customer expected partial counts. Proposal: change billing_worker to accept partial flush on connection_close and add a short grace period (2s) to allow late finalizes. Need design sign-off from @chao.

chao_engineering: Agree to partial flush on close + 2s grace. I'll open a PR to the runtime that emits `event: finalize_partial` on socket close, and update billing_worker to consume it. Tentative patch ETA: 24–36h. I'll include a feature flag.

alex_support: Thx — I'll tell the customer we have a fix in progress and will reconcile historical discrepancy after deploy. Offer a one-time credit if they prefer a faster reconciliation.

maria_billing: I'll prepare reconciliation script once PR is merged — probably can backfill partial tokens from logs for affected window.

alex_support: Closing loop: customer notified, support+billing+eng aligned. Will follow up with PR link and timeline.
